elements.caption: AI analysis → tasks from documents, ingredients from recipes

items.caption:
TO-DO LISTS — tasks from documents
Notices from school or daycare, parent letters, letters from authorities or the doctor, appointment slips, invitations. Deadlines and appointments found in the text become due dates.

SHOPPING LISTS — ingredients from recipes
The ingredients arrive as articles with quantity and category. Before adding them you can change the number of servings; every amount scales along.

SOURCES
Link — paste a recipe address; the gateway loads the page and reads the ingredients from it. Recipes only.
Photo — camera shot of a cookbook page, a handwritten note, a package or a document.
File — JPG, PNG or PDF from storage. A multi-page PDF is analysed as a whole, so a two-page recipe or a long letter works too.

SAVING RECIPES
Recognised ingredients can be stored as a favorite list under a name of your choice — together with their source: the link, or the photo respectively the PDF as a media object below "Rezeptfotos". "Open recipe" later shows that original again.

Privacy notice

popup.caption: Privacy notice for the AI analysis

items.caption:
WHAT IS TRANSMITTED
Only what you hand over for one analysis: the photo, the PDF, or — for a recipe link — the text of that page. Documents you photograph for the to-do list are transmitted as an image and may contain names, addresses or health data; check before scanning whether that is acceptable to you.

WHO RECEIVES IT
The provider selected below. Anthropic and OpenAI process the data on their servers, outside your home network and possibly outside the EU; their API terms apply. A local server (e.g. Ollama) receives everything inside your own network — nothing leaves the house.

WHAT IS STORED
This gateway does not keep the analysed photos or PDFs; they exist only for the duration of the request. Exception: if you save a recipe as a favorite list, the photo respectively the PDF is stored deliberately as a media object below "Rezeptfotos" and stays until you delete that list. The API key is stored in this instance's configuration on your server and never reaches the apps.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITY
You operate this system. If you have documents of other people analysed — family members, letters from third parties — you are the controller under the GDPR. Consent can be withdrawn at any time; the AI analysis is switched off with it.

REQUIREMENTS AND COSTS
Your own API key is required. Anthropic and OpenAI charge a few cents per analysis and receive the photo, the PDF or the recipe text. A local server (e.g. Ollama) keeps everything inside your network, but needs a vision-capable model — and one that accepts documents if you want to analyse PDFs. Keys: console.anthropic.com / platform.openai.com. The key is stored in this instance's configuration on your server.
